name: Tea Party Prelude: Artful Latte

descriptions.normal: A latte well worth savoring. Carefully ground from specially roasted coffee beans, it is finished with delicate foam art, soft and dense as mist. Its flavor is rich and mellow, with an unusually refined aroma that sets it apart.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

sources: Claim Daily Commissions with Sandrone in the party
